origin: Core-ledger recovery (same night) exposed 68 RISK_DENY_PDT refusals across 9 days / 18 unique entry intents — the single largest category of trades the engine wanted and never took. J goal: 'unlock more trades from historic data'.
question: On PAPER accounts, the engine self-imposes the live PDT rule (3 day-trades / 5 business days under $25k). Did that self-imposed constraint COST money or SAVE money?
why_it_is_live: Alpaca paper does not enforce PDT — this is a deliberate engine-side simulation of the live constraint. It is defensible ONLY if it is not destroying research power for free. Two independent reasons it may be wrong: (a) the growth ladder targets >=$25k accounts where PDT does not apply at all, so paper is rehearsing a constraint the target state never has; (b) blocking every trade after the 3rd in a rolling window yields a SYSTEMATICALLY BIASED subsample (early-window entries only), which corrupts every downstream WR/expectancy estimate, not just the blocked rows.
population: All status == RISK_DENY_PDT rows in core-decisions.jsonl carrying a symbol, deduped to unique (account, symbol, date) intents. Measured 2026-08-11: 68 attempts -> 18 unique intents, 2026-07-08 .. 2026-08-07.
method: Price each blocked intent at its LOGGED qty and premium, on real OPRA 5-min bars, through the real exit_manager via multileg_exit_walk at calibration v5 (extreme fills, $0.01 slippage, SPY union feed). Exit shape = that account's params.json config (safe/bold), the same shape its PLACED siblings ran that day.

gates.G1_net_positive: blocked cohort net P&L > 0 (PDT cost us money)
gates.G2_day_balance: count(profitable blocked days) > count(losing blocked days)
gates.G4_not_concentrated: no single day is more than 60% of a positive net

decision_rule: ALL gates pass -> propose relaxing the paper-side PDT simulation behind a per-arm flag, default OFF, one arm armed, with a forward kill criterion. ANY gate fails -> PDT stays exactly as-is and the result is filed as 'the constraint was protective (or neutral)'. Either way the number gets published.
known_limitations_stated_before_running: NAIVE counterfactual: taking a blocked trade would have shifted the rolling PDT window and could have blocked a DIFFERENT later trade. This measures the marginal value of the blocked intents in isolation, not a full sequential re-simulation. A positive result therefore licenses a forward trial, never a direct ship.
Capital is assumed non-binding (bold equity $5,478 vs ~$500/position); flag if any intent violates the arm's risk cap.
n=18 is below the advisory n>=20 bar. A pass is SUGGESTIVE, not sufficient on its own.
explicitly_forbidden: Dropping losing days; re-picking the exit shape after seeing results; converting a pass into a live-money change (PDT is a real regulatory rule for live accounts under $25k and is NOT being questioned there).
